crossRefs.note: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you…
Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and tell them; and they went and…
Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how Yahweh has avenged him of his enemies.”

parallels.note: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

translations.web: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”
translations.bsb: Indeed, their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with everything you hear.”
translations.kjv: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
translations.asv: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok's son, and Jonathan, Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me everything that ye shall hear.
